reader.requirement: At --std 85 a body group's NEXT GROUP sets LINE-COUNTER (or the saved next group integer) and so moves the next body group; a report heading's NEXT GROUP moves the page heading (absolute, relative, or NEXT PAGE = the RH alone on page 1); a page footing's NEXT GROUP moves a relative report footing.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.SavedNextGroupForcesPageAdvance (active from 2002): at 85 a saved absolute NEXT GROUP integer is read only after a failed fit test (3a/3b/3c) instead of forcing the page advance
DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (active from 2002): at 85 TERMINATE keeps the saved next group integer for the control footings it produces

reader.edition-search: ApplyNextGroup consults no edition (read whole); the edition reaches the clause's effect only through the two saved-next-group DialectBehavior switches.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only on the absolute NEXT GROUP saved-integer path (85: the next body group meets the saved integer after a failed fit test; TERMINATE keeps the save); the RH->PH and PF->RF effects are the same code at every edition

reader.notes: ApplyNextGroup is the one place the clause takes effect for RH, PF and body groups; its effect on the NEXT group is realized by FirstLineTarget reading LINE-COUNTER (PH with an RH on the page, RF after a PF) and by the save location for body groups. p3ng4 prints the same at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-234/r3ng.cob (run r3ng-001). R1: RH NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE prints RH@2 alone on page 1, with no page footing on page 1 (§1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR4c). A body NEXT GROUP PLUS 15 from line 8 gives LC 23, and the next DE fails the fit. PF LINE 26 NEXT GROUP 27 then moves the relative RF to 27 + 2 = 29 on the last page. R2: RH LINE 2 NEXT GROUP 3 moves the relative PH to 4. CF KB NEXT GROUP 15 at its own break moves the next DE to 16. At the KA break, CF KB's NEXT GROUP is ignored because it is not the highest level (§1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR3): FB@17, FA@18, and FA's NEXT GROUP PLUS 3 gives LC 21, so the next DE advances to page 2 (PH@1, D2@6). r1sav covers the saved absolute integer through two page advances. Refusals at 85: c5 (WITH RESET) and c6 (NEXT GROUP + 2) give COBOL0900. cite.py: `OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR4c  ... the text is in GR4c`; `OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR3  ... the text is in GR3`.
